payload.reason: The evidence discusses the generation of additional data from translations, specifically mentioning the size of the extra data and its impact on performance.

claims.text: The size of the extra data used in the study is about 10 times larger than the 2-votes data due to reliance on additional training data and intra-sentential instances.
Using back-translations of explicitated connectives improves discourse relation parsing performance, indicating that translations can generate valuable additional data.
High quality translation data shows better generalisability, outperforming other settings in cross-validation, suggesting effective use of additional data from translations.
